title: Meet Renata
body: Renata keeps 14 contract clinicians cleared to work at 9 partner facilities, in about 6 hours a week. Here's her Monday before and after this tool.

title: Every clearance, one view
body: Each clinician at each facility gets its own row, showing what's still missing and how many days until their first scheduled study.

title: The full packet history
body: Every document, facility reply and follow-up for a packet, in one timeline, with expiration dates shown next to each item.

title: A blocked start, caught early
body: The facility returned this packet because the liability certificate expires too soon. It shows up here the same day, not at the next email check.

title: The start date is visible
body: A live countdown to the clinician's first scheduled study, so you can see how much time is left to fix the packet.

title: Renata still decides
body: Nothing goes back to a facility until Renata checks the documents and the cover note and clicks send herself.

title: The numbers that matter
body: Clearance rate, average days to clear, blocked packets and documents expiring soon, all computed from the packet data.

title: How this would be built
body: Documents sit in encrypted storage, a model reads expiration dates from uploads under a BAA, Slack carries owner alerts with no clinician data in them, and every facility send needs staff approval.
